track: Track 1 — Development of Multimodal Content Creation Tools

officialSubmission.method: Fork the official GitHub repository and open an English pull request containing the submission.
officialSubmission.proposedPullRequestTitle: Track 1, ProofLaunch, ProofLaunch Evidence-Grounded Campaign Studio

trackRequirements.application: A practical, lightweight, high-performance multimodal content-creation tool implementing at least one accepted creation, editing, enhancement, styling, batch-remix, or image/video generation scenario.
trackRequirements.hardware: Use AMD Radeon GPU and ROCm and deploy or demonstrate on the designated AMD environment.
modelPolicy: Open-source models may be modified and optimized.
LoRA, ControlNet, lightweight inference, and distilled models are allowed.
The core function must not rely only on a closed online API.
At least one key inference process must run locally on AMD Radeon GPU.

deliverables.requirement: All submission materials, project descriptions, and pull requests are in English.
PDF covering background, target users and scenarios, architecture, model and algorithm, and Radeon/ROCm adaptation.
Complete source repository and README covering environment, startup, and dependencies.
Recommended 3–5 minute demo showing actual operation and actual Radeon execution from CLI or GUI through final results, including clarity, stability, and diversity.
deliverables.reason: A truthful final demo requires a completed real Radeon run.

deliverables.requirement: Choose one PPT or poster highlighting creative scenarios and practical value.
Fork the official repository and open an English pull request titled in the required Track, Team, Application format.
deliverables.reason: No WhatGhost fork is currently observable, and the PR must remain unopened until the real Radeon run and demo evidence pass.
